prompt: Split-screen diptych with left-right scenario contrast. Left side: illuminated by a soft, warm bone white spotlight from above left, casting a short shadow. Right side: illuminated by a harsh, cool blue-white spotlight from above right, casting a long shadow. Studio product photograph, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, catalogue clarity, fine film grain, no text, no logos.
